note_for_next_ai: The repo is the source of truth, not any handover text. Verify a file exists before trusting a status list. ALWAYS run `git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/<branch>` before committing: the sandbox has been silently reset to an old base more than once. The app is AI ASSistant, NOT a Claude clone - do not reintroduce Claude branding. Nothing fake goes in front of the user: a screen may not exist without working. NOTE 2026-10-14: the desktop checkers had been running the app through puppeteer.connect() with the default 800x600 viewport applied to a window it did not create, so every screenshot showed a cramped window nobody sees; `defaultViewport: null` fixed all of them. Use it in any new checker.

features_implemented: The Artifacts screen: a real library on disk (append-only versions, atomic index, remove moves files to the library's own .trash and names where, a damaged index is repaired from the files, path traversal refused before it is a path), with real thumbnails (script-less sandbox, loaded only near the viewport), version chips that preview and re-save an older version, rename/duplicate/copy-out/export-folder, adoption of artifacts already in saved conversations, and the folder named in a footer

Browsing Maps: a timeline of what the vault holds (conversations, captured pages, visits) with site grouping, kind filters, search and a time window, read from the vault through /api/vault/sources — a visit is labelled a visit, never reading

Settings > Agent access: switches for the local model, browser captures, keeping conversations and each keyed provider — every one enforced in the main process (refused before anything leaves or is written), with the not-built capabilities stated as such
Every reply labelled where it came from: local, or online · <provider>

Extension port on 127.0.0.1:8765: the browser extension can post captures, read context and capsules, and round-trip the never-check list — capture side only, chrome-extension:// origins only, visible in Settings > System
Real chat against Ollama at 127.0.0.1:11434 with streaming, abort, regenerate, edit-and-resend, branching
Artifacts: extracted from replies, sandboxed preview, code view, version history, ZIP export
Comment mode: append-only rewrite of one artifact at a time with versions
Vault writes: every finished conversation becomes Markdown in the vault, with 09 Activity & Undo appended
Settings as a full window (rail + panes): System, Appearance, Performance, Vault, plus search and per-section Reset
Appearance rewrites the theme tokens themselves (accent, conversation width) and survives reload
Performance: Ollama options from profile presets or custom values, measured against the chosen profile
Vault folder chosen through the main process; missing folders are refused and never replaced

Online providers (Claude/Anthropic, GPT/OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Grok, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint): off until a key is saved in Settings > Models, key sealed by the machine and never handed to the interface
Cloud models named provider/model and answered through the same /api/ollama/chat address, as the same NDJSON records — one streaming path for local and online alike
Browser preview build that states plainly it is the interface only

Windows installer (NSIS, assisted, per-user, unsigned): AI-ASSistant-Setup-0.1.0.exe (~84 MB) built by electron-builder 26.15.3 from electron-builder.yml, icon rendered from the app's own BrainMark, en-US locale only, maximum compression; release notes in apps/03_ai-assistant/RELEASE-WINDOWS.md
The sidebar collapses to a 56px rail and can be dragged 200-420px wide (double-click resets); both remembered. The chat's artifacts rail hides and returns

The logo's internal ids are stripped to letters and digits before entering url(#...) references (React 19 wraps useId in punctuation, which is unsafe there), and the window icon is wired for the development build
known_gaps: Most of the mockups' screens do not exist yet: Today, Vault, Projects, Code and the first-run welcome screen. The nav names only what works, in one muted line, rather than drawing dead entries
Artifacts step 1b: the Import button (file picker in the main process) and Tweaks (design-token sliders over the existing withDesignTokens machinery)
The extension itself is still a starter: it is not loaded, not ported into this app's flow, and captures nothing until it is - so Browsing Maps is mostly what the app itself kept
Agent access governs what exists (models, captures, keeping, provider keys); Files, Shell, Web and MCP appear as "not built yet" until each one exists
